about: The site Verse is taking on. It passes when Verse leads or ties on everything measured, is behind on nothing, meets Verse's own bar (fast, mobile, accessible, correct on its main job) and is better on one thing; the rest is conquered in the background. No site holds the Tower more than 1 day (tools/tower-target.mjs).
